actions.name: running leap
actions.desc: With a 10-foot running start, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can &reference[long jump] up to 25 feet.

actions.name: pack tactics
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't &reference[incapacitated apply=false].

actions.name: keen smell
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell.

actions.name: pounce
actions.desc: If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} moves at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and then hits it with a @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.monsters.Actor.hjhERRzafCiFFVLA.Item.CHIayoaCAZj0GBkM]{claw} attack on the same turn, that target must succeed on a [[/save]] saving throw or be knocked &Reference[prone]. If the target is prone, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can make one [[/item .gKj1TlVfDhLp5WIk]]{bite} attack against it as a bonus action.
